experiences.description:
ADVIDS is a Web-Based Video Creation Service with specialization in application of Motion Graphics for strategic business communication. 

Advids is trusted by 2000+ leading organizations, brands & startups globally – including United Nations, European Union, The World Bank, Google, Walmart, Mercedes-Benz, Bosch, Swarovski & Verizon Wireless.

The company currently has customers in United States, Canada, Brazil, United Kingdom, France, Germany, Switzerland, Italy, UAE, Singapore, Australia, China, Japan and India .
